instruction:
Implement WP-SCP-022 Track 2 slice 021E per WP-SCP-021 §4 row 021E.

The propose() tool stub already partially exists from slice 021C (now on main). 021E completes the hardening: full anti-spam (rate-limit + normalised-text-hash dedupe within 24h), silent-rot banner (auto-injected proposal-body front-matter), proposal envelope (mcp_origin + caller_id + signing_key_id).

## Acceptance criteria

1. **propose() signature**: `propose(title: str, body: str, affected_repos: list[str], rule_id: Optional[str]) → {proposal_id, branch, path, pr_url_if_pushed, adjudication_status, expected_review_date}`.

2. **Anti-spam — rate limit**: 10 proposals per caller per rolling hour. SCP-MCP-E020 (already defined in 021C catalogue — extend remediation text if needed) on exceeded.

3. **Anti-spam — normalised-text-hash dedupe**: identical-body submissions within 24h refused with SCP-MCP-E020. Normalisation: strip markdown markers, collapse whitespace, case-fold (existing 021C normalisation already handles Unicode-Cf / bidi controls per fr2 — extend with markdown stripping). Hash via sha256 of normalised text; store last 1024 hashes (LRU eviction).

4. **Silent-rot banner — front-matter auto-injection**: every PROP-NNN.md begins with:
   ```
   ---
   adjudication_status: queued_no_adjudicator
   expected_review_date: null
   queued_at: <ISO-8601>
   ---
   > NOTE: WP-SCP-022-proposal-queue adjudication workflow is not yet live;
   > proposals queue until adjudication ships. Status updates land via
   > GitHub issue on this branch (proposals/PROP-NNN). See
   > docs/plans/WP-SCP-022-implementation-programme-plan.md §12.
   ```

5. **Proposal envelope** (every proposal carries):
   - `mcp_origin: true`
   - `caller_id: <stdio-session-keyed-PID-or-MCP-client-id>`
   - `signing_key_id: <key-id of the signing key when proposal was generated>`

6. **stdio session identity (closes WP-SCP-021 U-21-f)**: caller_id is derived from stdio session — pid + path. Document the derivation in WP-SCP-021 §13 Resolution column for U-21-f.

7. **Tests at `tests/scp_mcp/test_tools/test_propose_hardening.py`**: rate-limit (11th call refused); dedupe (identical-body within 24h refused); banner injection (PROP-NNN.md starts with the banner front-matter); envelope fields (mcp_origin, caller_id, signing_key_id present).

## Constraints

- propose() is a STUB — does NOT actually merge proposals (that's WP-SCP-022-proposal-queue, separately tracked).
- Don't add tools or resources beyond propose() hardening.
- Don't change DECISIONS/BACKLOG/STATUS. D-021 reservation respected.

## Self-test

- `python3 -m pytest tests/scp_mcp/ -xvs` green (existing 66 tests + new propose-hardening tests).
